No. 2083/4 – TUESDAY, AUGUST, 07, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
(Notice Under Section 07)

My No.: 3/6/2016/7/2(2018). Land Ministry No.: 4-3/7/2016/HW/140. I do hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, That the government intends to acquire the following lands/ servitudes which required for a public purpose:- Schedule of the Land Acquired: Two (02) Allotments of land in extent of 0.0205 hectare depited as Priliminary plan No. ý 2395 of 25.06.2018 (lots 1 to 2) prepared by the senior Superintendent of surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General Situated in the villages of Nillakkegama in 888 Dewategedara Grama Niladari Divisions of Polgahawela Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kurunegala District, North western province. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Waragaspitiyahena, Aswedduma; Land Use : Garden, Temporary Plantation; Claimant: State; Original claimant: K.P.H. Daya Menike Herath, No. 135/5, Diggale watta, Colombo Road, Potuhera; Extent : 0.0068 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Elhena, Ambagahamulahena; Land Use : Garden, Temporary Plantation; Claimant: State;
Original claimant: G. Sriyani Pushpa Kumari, Nillakkegama, Lindakumbura, Mahapitiya, Potuhera; Extent : 0.0137 Hectare.

All persons whom interested in the aforesaid lands/servitudes is to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or through an agent duly authorized in writing, before me at divisional secretariat Kurunegala on the day of 19.07.2018, in nature of their claims for compensation for the said lands/Servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of compensation of such amount, further the person should appear for an inquiry under section 09 of the act Commence from 08.08.2018 on wards. The date of inquiry and the relevant documents submit at the inquiry such as deeds may duly informed by me.
If an agent may present at the inquiry, Original claimant of the land must be duly authorized in writing, Without such a letter statement or evidence may not be recorded from such an agent.
D. ANOMA DISANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary & Land Acquiring Officer, Polgahawela.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Polgahawela. 08-714

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
(Notice Under Section 7)
My No.: 4/1/1/32/E. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/7/2015/HW/69.

I hereby give notice, under sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, That the government intends to acquire the following lands/servituds which are required for a public purpose:- Description of the Land acquired: Two (02) lots in extent of 0.5457 hectares depited as Priliminary plan No. ý 2366 of 28.05.2018 prepared by the senior Superintendent of surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General Situated in the villages of Ambalanpitiya, in No.808, Weherabenda and No. 836, Theliyagonna Grama Niladari Divisions of Kurunegala Divisional Secretary’s Division in Kurunegala District, North Western Province and further described as follows. 01. Lot No. 130 Name of the Land: Kolapelellakandawatta; Land Use : Garden and Mixed Plantation; Claimant: State; Original claimant: H.P.N.K. Pathirana and P.S.B. Monarawila; Extent : 0.1029 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 131 Name of the Land: Kolapelellakandawatta; Land Use : Garden and Mixed Plantation and Permanent Building; Claimant: State; Original claimant: M.T. Nuwan Gethal Perera, No. 115, Colombo Road, Diulapitiya; Extent : 0.4428 Hectare.

All persons whom interested in the aforesaid land/servitudes is to be acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or through an agent duly authorized in writing, before me at divisional secretariat Kurunegala on the day of 15.08.2018, in nature of their claims for compensation for the said lands/Servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of compensation of such amount, further the person should appear for an inquiry under section 09 of the act Commence from 30.08.2018 on wards. The date of inquiry and the relevant documents submit at the inquiry such as deeds may duly informed by me.
If an agent may present at the inquiry, Original claimant of the land must be duly authorized in writing, Without such a letter statement or evidence may not be recorded from such an agent.
E.M.M.S. EKANAYAKA, Divisional Secretary and Land Acquiring Officer, Kurunegala.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Kurunegala, 2nd August, 2018 08-715
